theorem_title: Persistent allocation ends bound selected wanted sources
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.wanted_selected_ends {pair bank cover srcB srcC NB NC g h J cut occ i j code stop : ℕ}
    (hg : 0<g) (hi : i<_root_.ThreeSum.BandPartition.size NB g) (hj : j<_root_.ThreeSum.BandPartition.size NC g)
    (hk : code<_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBlockSourceCatalog.count h J)
    (hsrcB : srcB+NB≤ stop) (hsrcC : srcC+NC≤ stop)
    (hpair : _root_.ThreeSum.SourceBandPairData.next pair NB NC g (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.BlockSourceEncoding.modulus h J)≤ stop)
    (hbank : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SourceBandBankData.finish bank NB NC g h J cut≤ stop)
    (hocc : occ+_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBlockSourceCatalog.count h J*J≤bank)
    (hcover : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightCoverKeyData.keyEnd cover h J≤ stop) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.WantedSourceEnds (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.ReportingHostSourceSelectionStored.retained pair bank cover NB NC g h J cut occ i j code)
      pair bank cover srcB srcC i j code h J cut stop := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let the positive band width be $g$, the selected band indices be valid for source lengths $N_B,N_C$, and the occurrence code be below the occurrence-bank count. Suppose the two original source arrays, pair catalog, complete source banks, occurrence rows, and cover-key payload satisfy their stated allocation-end bounds at address $s$, with the occurrence rows ending before the bank. Then the concrete retained selector satisfies every individual source-end bound at $s$.

Connects whole persistent allocations to the exact selected pointers passed to wanted reporting. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
